title: Multi-round discussion
description: Define multi-model discussions as a workflow: rounds run serially, and each round can run in parallel or serial. Placeholders bind to real models at chat time.
name: Name
placeholderRequired: At least one model placeholder is required
roundRequired: Every round needs at least one step
roundIndependent: Every model answers independently in this round.
roundSeesPrevious: In a parallel round, every model sees the previous round and all earlier discussion.
roundSerial: A serial round runs models 1, 2, 3…N in order; later models see and respond to earlier answers from the same round.
summaryHint: After the rounds, the summary model turns the successful turns into the final answer for the user.
workflowHint: Rounds run serially, and each round can be parallel or serial. Parallel models answer independently; serial models read and respond to earlier answers in model order. The summary model then writes the final answer. Placeholders bind to real models at chat time.
